| # SID - CommunicationControl (0x28) {#sid---communicationcontrol-0x28-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                  |                                                                                                                                           |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The Communication Control (SID 0x28) service is used to enable or disable the transmission and/or reception of communication messages on the ECU (server).

This service can be used, for example, to temporarily stop the transmission of application communication messages while maintaining diagnostic communication.

## Supported Sub-Functions {#supported-sub-functions .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  -------------- ---------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Sub-Function   Name                   Description
  0x00           enableRxAndTx          Enables both reception and transmission of messages for the specified communication type.
  0x01           enableRxAndDisableTx   Enables reception and disables transmission of messages for the specified communication type.
  0x02           disableRxAndEnableTx   Disables reception and enables transmission of messages for the specified communication type.
  0x03           disableRxAndTx         Disables both reception and transmission of messages for the specified communication type.
  -------------- ---------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Callback Functions {#callback-functions .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The callback functions for the supported sub-functions are implemented in the bds_diag_appl_adapt.c file.

1\.  Sub function 0x00 : bds_uds_EnableRXTX()

The transmission and reception of communication messages can be enabled using the following APIs:

 a) CAN based signal : below API starts all message groups that were previously set

          bds_can_startAllMsgGroups(bds_IPduGrpVctr_au8, 1)        

 b) XCP: below API enables XCP

          bds_xcp_setMode(BDS_ENABLE_XCP)

 c) CAN start:

          bds_can_start(BDS_CAN_1_D)

2\.  Sub function 0x01 : bds_uds_EnableRxAndDisableTx()

The application software (ASW) shall define the behavior required to:

- Enable the reception of cyclic messages.

- Disable the transmission of cyclic messages.

3\.  Sub function 0x02 : bds_uds_DisableRxAndEnableTx()

The application software (ASW) shall define the behavior required to:

- Disable the reception of cyclic messages.

- Enable the transmission of cyclic messages.

4\. Sub function 0x03 : bds_uds_DisableRxAndTx()

The transmission and reception of communication messages can be disabled using the following APIs:

 a) CAN based signal : Please refer below:

          Stopping of Message/PDUs

 b) XCP: below API disables XCP

          bds_xcp_setMode(BDS_DISABLE_XCP)

 c) CAN stop

          bds_can_stop(BDS_CAN_1_D)

## Request and Response Format {#request-and-response-format .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

### Communication Control Request {#communication-control-request .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ------ ---------------------------- -------------
  Byte   Parameter                    Value
  1      Service Identifier (SID)     0x28
  2      Sub-Function (controlType)   0x00 - 0xFF
  3      communicationType            0x00 - 0xFF
  ------ ---------------------------- -------------

### Supported Sub-Functions {#supported-sub-functions-1 .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The current implementation supports the following sub-functions:

- 0x00 -- enableRxAndTx

- 0x01 -- enableRxAndDisableTx

- 0x02 -- disableRxAndEnableTx

- 0x03 -- disableRxAndTx

### communicationType Parameter {#communicationtype-parameter .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The communicationType parameter allows one or more communication types to be controlled simultaneously.

Only bits 1--0 are evaluated. Bits 7--2 shall be set to zero.

  ------------ ------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Bits (1-0)   Value   Description
  01b          0x01    Normal communication messages
  10b          0x02    Network management communication messages
  11b          0x03    Normal communication messages and network management communication messages
  ------------ ------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Example Request:\
Enable Reception and Disable Transmission of Normal Communication Messages

  ------------ -------------- -------------------
  Service ID   Sub-Function   communicationType
  0x28         0x01           0x01
  ------------ -------------- -------------------

 

Positive Response

  -------------- -----------------
  Response SID   Sub Function ID
  0x68           0x01
  -------------- -----------------
